scope: Same consumed 149-formula oracle-group diagnostic; 96 legacy and 53 Codex-reviewed cases. No training or product replacement.

linear_margin_diagnostic.rival: Final challenger's highest nontruth rival, fixed for all three decomposition terms
linear_margin_diagnostic.limit: Exact linear decomposition up to FP32 rounding, not an accuracy-attribution percentage or causal architecture proof.

next_controlled_experiment: Cold canonical, identical V16 broad real inputs/views/schedule/2400-step budget/loss, freeze all 55 encoder/pooling tensors and train only the two head tensors. Compare both internal development and owned-input nonregression; do not train on the 149 acceptance-derived cases.
interpretation: In this diagnostic encoder/pooling updates have a larger negative effect than the head-only update. Freezing the backbone is the next smaller controlled learning intervention; no evidence establishes that the architecture lacks representational capacity.
